screens.title: Pusat Edukasi & Dashboard Keamanan Digital
screens.purpose: Menyajikan fondasi literasi siber, kerangka Think Before You Click, ringkasan 4 taktik rekayasa sosial, dan navigasi utama ke analisis dan kuis
screens.stitchPromptBrief: A modern, highly trustworthy digital safety learning dashboard in light mode. Centered around a 60/40 asymmetric split hero with a prominent typography headline 'Kenali Manipulasi Digital Sebelum Terlambat', deep navy text (#152238), restrained teal CTA button (#176B68), clean white surfaces, hairline borders (#DCE4ED), an interactive 3-step action guide, and a 4-card grid detailing social engineering tactics. Clean, academic, and practical without generic dark hacker tropes.

screens.title: Penganalisis Pesan Forensik Berbasis Bukti
screens.purpose: Menganalisis teks pesan mencurigakan berbasis aturan heuristik bukti nyata dengan estimasi risiko kualitatif transparan tanpa angka persentase palsu
screens.stitchPromptBrief: A clinical and focused cybersecurity forensic analysis tool in light mode. Features a clean multiline textarea with a character counter, pre-filled scenario buttons for quick testing, a yellow-tinted privacy caution box, and a rich results card showing a bold qualitative risk badge (High/Medium/Low), tagged evidence chips, plain-language reasoning, and a mitigation checklist. Clear empty and loading states included.

screens.title: Kuis Keputusan Siber Interaktif
screens.purpose: Melatih pengambilan keputusan keamanan siber melalui 5 skenario studi kasus kontekstual Indonesia dengan umpan balik edukatif seketika
screens.stitchPromptBrief: An interactive, educational single-question scenario quiz screen in light mode. Displays a clean linear progress indicator, a prominent framed simulation card depicting a realistic message bubble, three distinct card-style decision options with radio selectors, an immediate color-coded educational feedback drawer, and an accessible end-of-quiz score review screen.
